name: Philippine Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars 4.13.2 (backfill; not independently verified): 249 closures (160 named; the 89 unnamed are exchange_calendars' one-offs and lunar or proclaimed holidays it lists ad hoc: Chinese New Year, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, elections, typhoon and event closures) and no early closes. None is moved to ad_hoc_closures: no PSE notice for them was read (4c12 rule: one-off closures go to ad_hoc_closures only on PSE's own word). No corrections. 2025-2026: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications. 2027-2029: standing pattern. Checked 2026-11-20 (4c12). Last published year: PSE's trading-holidays page (https://www.pse.com.ph/trading-holidays/) was not readable this session; Malacanang's Proclamation No. 1427 sets the 2027 national holidays, but PSE's own 2027 list was not read. Hours (4c13): PSE's notice CN-2022-0009 of 17 February 2022 (https://documents.pse.com.ph/CircularOPSPDF/CN-2022-0009.pdf), effective 1 March 2022 'until further notice', gives pre-open 09:00, pre-open no-cancel 09:15, market open 09:30, market recess 12:00, market resumption 13:00, pre-close 14:45, pre-close no-cancel 14:48, run-off/trading at last 14:50, market close 15:00. CN-2021-0059 of 22 November 2021 (https://documents.pse.com.ph/CircularOPSPDF/CN-2021-0059.pdf) gave the same schedule from 6 December 2021, but shortened hours applied from 14 January 2022 (CN-2022-0004, not read), so the dated entry starts 2022-03-01, the date both notices support without a break. Under ADR 0013 the close is 14:50, the end of the pre-close (closing) auction; run-off/trading at last 14:50-15:00 is post_market; the 12:00-13:00 recess is a lunch_break; pre-open 09:00-09:30 is pre_market. The earlier entry (09:30-15:00 from 2010-01-01, continuous) is the file's value before 4c13 and is unconfirmed: PSE's schedules before 2022-03-01 differ and are leads, not sourced here: Memorandum 2010-0340 (effective 26 July 2010: recess 12:00-14:00, pre-close 15:47-15:50, run-off 15:50-16:00), a later 13:30 resumption and 15:15-15:20 pre-close (2013), the move to a 13:00 resumption, the 2020-2022 shortened and half-day schedules (CN-2021-0063 for 24 and 31 December 2021). Undated sessions describe the 2022-03-01 entry. Half days are not modelled as early closes.
